<a id="zipzi-connect"></a>

## zipzi.connect

```python
def connect(*, endpoint: Path | None=None, start: bool=False, host: Path | None=None, timeout: float=10.0, startup_timeout: float=15.0, sdk_build: str | None=None) -> Runtime:
    ...
```

Connect to an Editor's private v4 endpoint; use as a context manager.

endpoint selects a host explicitly. Without it, discover the running host.
start=True allows launching host (an absolute Editor executable path) when
needed. timeout bounds calls; startup_timeout bounds host startup. sdk_build
optionally pins a build. Install the matching client/native pair for local().
Closing this client detaches its documents; edits require a separate save.

Related: [zipzi.Runtime](runtime.md#zipzi-runtime)

<a id="zipzi-snapshot"></a>

## zipzi.Snapshot

```python
class Snapshot[T = Any]
```

A query value tied to an exact source and immutable content identity.

value has the response shape selected by the query. records(Type) decodes
object/collection payloads into generated values. Reuse source for subsequent
pages or dependent reads; publication makes an old source stale.
content identifies resident content, not a persistent file hash. Opening or
importing creates a new identity; verify reloaded object fields and pixels.

| Field | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `source` | `v.QuerySource` |
| `content` | `str` |
| `value` | `T` |

<a id="zipzi-snapshot-records"></a>

### zipzi.Snapshot.records

```python
def records[U: Value](self, record_type: type[U]) -> tuple[U, ...]:
    ...
```

Decode all object records in order, e.g. snapshot.records(values.Mesh).

Use a query selecting the corresponding object kind. Mixed-kind reads
should decode individual payloads with Type.from_wire instead. Invalid
payloads raise TypeError/ValueError; summary/capability queries are rejected.

## zipzi.Job

```python
class Job[T]
```

Owned asynchronous work. wait() returns its projected result of type T.

A wait timeout retains the job. Context exit closes it, cancelling unfinished
work, so catch JobTimeout inside the context if you intend to wait again.

Render this entry without expanding children or referenced types.

<a id="zipzi-describe"></a>

## zipzi.describe

```python
def describe(path: str='zipzi', *, offset: int=0, limit: int=32) -> ApiDescription:
    ...
```

Read installed help without a host, native backend or network.

Paths include Session.query, Snapshot.records, results.SaveReceipt and
values.CommandCreateParameter. Enumerate values or a union's subclasses
using children; next_offset continues the same entry. Each page has at most
64 children. Ordinary help(object) and inspect.signature(object) also work.

Related: [zipzi.ApiDescription](runtime.md#zipzi-apidescription)
